provenance: The hardware units verified all 659 implementation, test and asset hashes at execution. The additional CPU-only interior spectral diagnostic was run independently twice with identical results, then included in the published manifest.

Per-star corner preparation verifies quarter-face ordering, sealed physical input and the extended table domain. Geometry and local thermal slopes use device Cartesian roots or independent original CPU roots/gradients. Original spectra, LD interpolation/optical-depth division and the reported finite data mapping are retained. The GPU helper performs host LD/atlas preparation and returns spectra to host before placement of the interpolation moments. The current path also builds centre spectra. All these costs are inside the enclosing timing.

Fine CPU probes and CPU correctness use cores16–19, nice19. Matched processes use cores0–15, nice10, BLAS and OMP single-threaded. Some CPU-only diagnostics overlapped early hardware units. Timings include fresh candidate preparation, two complete finite light curves, original third-light and normalization, physical prior, noise and density, resolution checks, all transfers and synchronized host results.

Each strict rectangle uses common integration grid 3, field levels 2/3, depths 2/3, slice order 8. The interior check uses 64 independent samples per quarter cell, original unirradiated thermal normalization and fresh CPU passband/LD tables at all query points. Its RMS errors do not bound a full irradiated likelihood.
Actual Colab execution and checkpointable physical chain convergence, posterior comparisons and ESS/sec remain pending on this model.
